description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות לחול מספקת פיצוי במקרה של תאונות, כולל כוויות ושברים. גובה הפיצוי עבור כוויה מחושב לפי אחוז השטח שנפגע, לדוגמה, כוויה מדרגה שנייה בשטח של 30% עשויה לזכות את המבוטח ב-$1,000. חשוב לציין שכוויה קטנה מ-4.5% אינה מזכה בפיצוי.
notable_values: Fracture in one limb: one payment
Multiple fractures in one limb: one payment

Example: The insured has a second degree burn with a 30% burn area and the maximum insurance amount stated on the burn insurance details page is $1,000, the insured will receive in this case: 50% X $1,000=500.
For the avoidance of doubt, a burn of less than 4.5% does not qualify for insurance benefits under this extended coverage.
The  calculation  of  the  area  of  the  burn  will  be  done according to the accepted methods: the method of ninths or a percentage of the surface area of the body (bsa).
It  is  clarified  that  the  diagnosis and determination of the severity of the burn and its scope according to this part, will be done by a specialist surgeon or plastic surgeon who examined the insured.
25.2.3.2.1. If a fracture occurs in more than one limb as a result of the same accident, the insurance sums for  the  fractures  in  the  various  limbs  will  be added as stated in the above table, provided that the total amount of the insurance benefits for all the fractures does not exceed the insurance amount specified in the table of liability limits for that insured for this coverage.
25.2.3.2.2. The company will not be liable and the insured will not be entitled to receive insurance benefits for fractures caused to the insured by or as a result of an illness or an ongoing gradual process

טבלה: פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות לחול - תנאים
This table details insurance compensation for accidents abroad, specifically covering burns and fractures. It outlines how benefits are calculated based on burn area percentage and fracture location, with maximum payout limits.
ממדים: Type of injury (burn, fracture), Severity/location of injury, insurance amount

Example: The insured has a second degree burn with a 30% burn area and the maximum insurance amount stated on the burn insurance details page is $1,000, the insured will receive in this case: 50% X $1,000=500.
For the avoidance of doubt, a burn of less than 4.5% does not qualify for insurance benefits under this extended coverage.
The  calculation  of  the  area  of  the  burn  will  be  done according to the accepted methods: the method of ninths or a percentage of the surface area of the body (bsa).
It  is  clarified  that  the  diagnosis and determination of the severity of the burn and its scope according to this part, will be done by a specialist surgeon or plastic surgeon who examined the insured.
25.2.3.2.1. If a fracture occurs in more than one limb as a result of the same accident, the insurance sums for  the  fractures  in  the  various  limbs  will  be added as stated in the above table, provided that the total amount of the insurance benefits for all the fractures does not exceed the insurance amount specified in the table of liability limits for that insured for this coverage.
25.2.3.2.2. The company will not be liable and the insured will not be entitled to receive insurance benefits for fractures caused to the insured by or as a result of an illness or an ongoing gradual process
